criteria.evidence: Generated Reviews transport client exposes typed operation inputs, outputs and faults; optional scoped Svelte bindings. Generation test and two sequential generations with git diff --exit-code passed.
Action tests cover synchronous duplicate fencing, trimmed notes, current policy and authority, and fresh rereads with both list and detail invalidation after conflicts and lost replies.
Action tests distinguish applied, superseded, already-resolved, round-changed, outcome-not-written and unknown outcomes, and prohibit refund remembering.

Browser portability test and UI host build pass; host fixtures resolve identical client, control and actions. Production route adoption and removal of host duplicates remain assigned to their adoption issues, outside this issue.
